transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’ve kind of stopped doing the things that usually make me feel like myself. I used to go on photography walks, help mentor the kids, keep my calendar really organized… and lately all of that just feels flat and heavy. I’m not really starting anything anymore, even things I normally care about.
Do you still enjoy the activities you used to like, even if you're not starting them as often?

Not really, no. Even when I think about doing them, like going out for photos or helping with the kids, it just feels kind of flat. I don’t get that same pull to start, and even my calendar stuff—which I used to like keeping in order—feels heavy now.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?
I don’t know if I’d call it sad most of the time. It’s more like I feel kind of flat and low, but not necessarily crying or anything like that. I’ve noticed it, but I’m not sure how to label it.
Do you still find pleasure in things that you normally would, like eating your favorite foods or spending time with loved ones?

Yeah… kind of. The main thing is the stuff that usually feels like me, like taking photography walks or mentoring the kids, just doesn’t feel rewarding lately. Even keeping my calendar clean, which I normally like, feels heavy. I just don’t really start those things anymore.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?
I haven’t really noticed any major change. I don’t weigh myself that often, but my clothes seem to fit about the same.
Have you been having any problems with your sleep lately?

Yeah, some nights I’m barely sleeping. I’ll sleep maybe two or three hours, wake up before dawn, and then I feel like I should just start answering emails or updating appointment lists instead of feeling tired.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than usual or having trouble sitting still?

I wouldn’t say I’m moving slower. It’s more the opposite during those stretches. I have trouble sitting still, and I start doing a bunch of things at once—rebuilding work templates, organizing files, making care plans, emailing relatives. It feels like if I stop, I’m dropping the ball somehow.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
I don’t think I feel sad most of the time. I mean, I have down moments like anyone, but it’s not a constant sadness that I’m aware of.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in?

Not as much, no. The things I usually enjoy—like going out for photography walks, helping mentor the kids, even keeping my calendar organized—started feeling kind of flat and heavy. I’ve just stopped starting those things on my own, even though they used to make me feel like myself.
Are there any small things that still bring you joy?

A few small things, maybe, but not like before. What really made me come in is that the stuff that usually makes me feel like myself—photography walks, mentoring the kids, even just keeping my calendar clean—started feeling flat and heavy. I just stopped starting those things on my own.
Do you feel like you're in a depressed mood most days?
I’m not sure I’d call it depressed most days. I feel kind of low or dulled out at times, but it’s not like I’m crying or feeling deeply sad every day. It’s more that things feel harder to get into.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It’s been about a year and three months, I think. It started after my family member’s health and behavior changed, and I ended up taking on more of the coordinating and keeping things together. Since then I’ve just felt this way on and off, but pretty consistently.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or enjoy doing?

I still kind of like the idea of them, but I don’t really get the pleasure from them like I used to. Photography walks, mentoring the kids, even just keeping my calendar organized—those used to make me feel like myself. Lately they just feel flat and heavy, and I don’t start them unless I’m really pushed.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities you used to enjoy?

Yes. That’s really what pushed me to come in. The things that usually make me feel like myself—like going out for photography walks, mentoring the kids, even just keeping my calendar clean—started feeling flat and heavy. I just don’t really start them on my own anymore.
Do you feel like you're in a depressed mood for most of the day?
I’m not sure I’d say most of the day. I do feel low a lot, but it kind of comes and goes. Some parts of the day I’m just flat more than sad.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past year?
I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed any big weight change over the past year.
Do you feel like you're in a depressed mood right now?
I’m not really sure. Right now I feel more kind of flat than clearly depressed.
Do you feel like you're in a depressed mood for most of every day?
Not really most of every day, no. It’s more like it comes in waves, and sometimes I just feel kind of numb or flat rather than depressed.
Do you feel like you're in a depressed mood for most of the day, more days than not?
I’m not sure I’d say most of the day, more days than not. It happens sometimes, but it’s not that consistent.
Do you feel like you're in a depressed mood for most of the day?
I don’t think it’s most of the day. It’s hard to pin down, but I wouldn’t describe it that way.
